gates.name: source admission
gates.object: finite bytes, language, logical path and declared resource context
gates.pass: intake admits the original bytes under size, UTF-8 and NUL rules and binds raw/normalised identities
gates.scope: No repaired substitute bytes. G1 does not assert Python syntax validity.

gates.name: observation availability
gates.precondition: G1 PASS and V2-valid observation record
gates.false_or_failure: valid not_applicable, insufficient_evidence or unavailable record: availability predicate false with its typed reason
gates.scope: Availability FAIL is not a malformed record or necessarily an analyser defect. Invalid V2 yields INVALID_INPUT, not a counterexample.

gates.name: value and codomain conformance
gates.object: observed atomic value with specification identity
gates.pass: value, unit, bounds and scale satisfy the versioned specification
gates.scope: Structural record validity and coordinate sufficiency are separately reported. No G3 PASS is inferred for a null unavailable value.

gates.name: local source-evidence adequacy
gates.object: normalised source identity, proposed coordinate cover and required visited spans
gates.precondition: structurally admitted source reference and a declared observation
gates.pass: every required visited span is contained in the admitted cover
gates.false_or_failure: uncovered required span or invalid reference
gates.scope: The visitor convention fixes which spans are required. Minimality and human comprehensibility are outside this predicate.

gates.name: policy interpretation
gates.object: applicable observation and declared versioned profile
gates.precondition: observed applicable value and admitted profile
gates.pass: decision equals the declared non-compensatory rule under that profile
gates.false_or_failure: wrong decision, profile identity or applicability handling
gates.scope: A correct different decision under another profile is a relational example, not G5 FAIL.

gates.name: consumer admission and source replay
gates.object: typed consumer record and source/profile/build context
gates.precondition: declared full-route request and explicit cross-carrier/context binding
gates.false_or_failure: a completed required subcheck fails; invalid context is INVALID_INPUT; missing subcheck is NOT_EVALUATED
gates.scope: Admission-only and replay-only results are not a full G6 PASS. S01 envelope and S04 capsule results remain separately typed; no implicit coercion.

V2.invariant: (state == observed) iff (value is not null); non-observed has a nonempty typed reason
V2.scope: Necessary representation invariant only; does not substitute for the full schema validator.

G5_relation.domain: same observed x/specification, two distinct admitted profiles pi and pi_prime
G5_relation.witness: D_pi(x) != D_pi_prime(x), with both policy evaluations conformant
G5_relation.conclusion: no single profile-independent function of x can give both outcomes
G5_relation.not_claimed: policy failure, statistical independence or all-pairs gate independence

threshold_domain: x,L,U integers; x>=0 and 0<=L<=U; bool excluded as an integer input

radius.theorem_falsifier: one admissible tuple violating the image identity; moving x across a boundary does not falsify that identity

G6_evaluation_precedence: wrong or absent context binding: INVALID_INPUT
any required completed subcheck FAIL: FAIL
